instruction: I'm on Ubuntu and would like to make LibreOffice Calc the default application for spreadsheet files. Can you configure this?

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting LibreOffice Calc as default spreadsheet application. Evaluator checks xdg-mime settings for spreadsheet MIME types (vnd.ms-excel, vnd.oasis.opendocument.spreadsheet) to verify libreoffice-calc.desktop is registered. Similar complexity to original VLC task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is semantically correct: queries multiple spreadsheet MIME types (vnd.ms-excel, vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, vnd.oasis.opendocument.spreadsheet, x-gnumeric) using xdg-mime to extract default app settings
Metric check_include_exclude correctly verifies that 'libreoffice-calc.desktop' is in the result string
Expected value 'libreoffice-calc.desktop' is correct for Ubuntu LibreOffice Calc registration
Data flow is correct: getter extracts the most common default app across MIME types, metric checks if it includes the expected value
Evaluator can semantically verify the instruction requirement of setting LibreOffice Calc as default spreadsheet application
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Getter returns the most common default app using Counter, which might not catch partial configurations where only some spreadsheet MIME types are set to LibreOffice Calc. Consider verifying that ALL queried MIME types have the same default app for stricter verification.
